data.title: A photograph from behind the rope
data.goal: Explain an access rule, distinguish a seasonal observation from long-term change, and return to the hide.

memoryNodes.location: Behind the rope, looking towards the reeds and nest.
memoryNodes.locationZh: 绳索后，面向芦苇和鸟巢。

memoryNodes.location: Beside the island marker and the migration map.
memoryNodes.locationZh: 小岛标杆与迁徙地图旁。

memoryNodes.cue: What decision does Lin bring back?
memoryNodes.location: Back at the hide door, beside the shell-shaped handle.
memoryNodes.locationZh: 返回观鸟屋门口，贝壳形把手旁。

data.situation: A rope kept visitors back from the reeds. The sign described breeding behaviour seen in spring. Lin could see two birds near a nest, but not whether their young would survive. Successful reproduction needed more evidence than one quiet afternoon. The ranger marked the visits as seasonal and asked for observations later in the year. A bird perched on the island marker. Behind it, a map traced a long migration route. One visitor wanted a closer photograph and suggested widening the boardwalk. Lin stayed behind the rope. A better view was not worth disturbing the nesting area. She followed the same boards back to the shell-shaped handle, carrying a photograph taken from a respectful distance.
data.zhSupport: 解释通行规则，区分季节观察与长期变化，再返回观鸟屋。

glossary.note: 看见行为不等于确认幼鸟最终存活。
reproduction 此处为生物繁殖，不是复制文本。
migration 在此指鸟类迁徙，不是人口移居。
表达位置，也可用于说明遵守访客边界。
perch 表示鸟停在某处；常接 on + 支撑物。

glossary.zh: 动物交配并产生后代的繁殖活动
glossary.note: 本课繁殖行为名词；原中文养育过宽，不能当成人类教养义。看见两只鸟靠近巢不独自证实所有繁殖阶段。

glossary.zh: 产生后代的生物繁殖过程
glossary.note: 生物过程名词，不是复制图片或文本。原课说幼鸟存活仍未知；本课观察者还不能判定这次繁殖结果。

glossary.zh: 季节性的；与某季节有关的
glossary.note: 本课记录只来自春季，需其他时段观察。seasonal不表示已经有多年记录。
本课地图上的鸟类迁徙，不是人口移居或分子内部迁移。一次看见鸟不确定它完整走过的路线。

glossary.zh: 停栖在枝条等支撑物上
glossary.note: 本课鸟类动词，常用perch on；故事perched是过去式。不是鲈鱼、栖木名词或旧长度单位。

glossary.zh: 四周被水包围的陆地；岛
glossary.note: 本课地图和标杆所指的小岛。不是道路中间的安全岛等比喻用法。
avoid后用动词-ing；本课说明距离规则保护巢区的目的，不把照片需要当成越界理由。
matchTexts: Stay behind the rope to avoid disturbing the nesting area.

glossary.text: We have seen …, but we do not yet know whether …
glossary.zh: 区分观察到的行为与未知结果
glossary.note: have seen给已经观察的事实；not yet know whether给未知问题。不会因为看见巢边两只鸟就预测幼鸟必定存活。
matchTexts: We have seen two birds near the nest, but we do not yet know whether their young will survive.

glossary.zh: 提出可行方案并承认代价
glossary.note: even if引出即使需要承担的代价；means后可以用-ing说明后果。本课更远拍照是守边界的代价。
matchTexts: Visitors could use a marked path, even if it means taking photographs from farther away.

glossary.zh: 从一处到另一处的路线
glossary.note: 本课migration route为地图上的迁徙路线；图示不代表本次观察已经追踪完整旅程。

retrievalPrompts.cue: A visitor wants to move closer to the nest. Explain why the rope should be respected.
acceptableAnswers: We should stay behind the rope to avoid disturbing the breeding area.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Give a practical rule and its purpose.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 游客想靠近鸟巢拍照。解释为何应遵守绳索边界。
checks: 给出留在绳索后的做法。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 位置表达和行为目的一起说。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Two birds are near a nest, but their young have not been observed. Explain what is still unknown.
acceptableAnswers: We have seen breeding behaviour, but we do not yet know whether the young will survive.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Separate observed behaviour from a later outcome.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 巢旁有两只鸟，但还没观察幼鸟。说明哪些看见了、哪些结果仍不知道。
checks: 已见的是鸟或记录的行为。
不把一次安静下午当成功繁殖证明。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 用完整未知问题，不用抽象结论代替观察。

retrievalPrompts.function: Explain the need for another visit
retrievalPrompts.cue: The only record comes from spring. Explain why another season should be observed.
acceptableAnswers: This is a seasonal observation, so we need visits at other times of the year.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: One season cannot describe the whole year.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 只有春季记录。解释为何要在其他时段再来。
checks: 不从地图推断本鸟已完成迁徙。
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: seasonal适合说明记录的时间范围，不需强塞migration。

transferPrompt.cue: A nature reserve wants more visitors without damaging a nesting area. Suggest one rule and acknowledge a cost.
acceptableAnswers: Visitors could use a marked path, even if it means taking photographs from farther away.
transferPrompt.feedback: Offer a workable rule and admit its effect on visitors.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 另一个保护区想接待更多游客，同时保护巢区。给一个规则，并承认游客要付出的代价。
checks: 承认拍照距离等具体代价。
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 迁移可行安排与代价表达，不照搬贝壳把手。

data.easySummary: Visitors stay behind a rope near the nests. Lin sees two birds, but she does not know whether their young will survive. The ranger asks for visits in other seasons. Lin takes a photograph from a distance and returns to the hide.
data.easySummaryZh: 游客留在鸟巢附近的绳索后。林看见两只鸟，却不知道幼鸟以后能否存活。管理员要求其他季节再观察。林从远处拍照，返回观鸟屋。
